In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], while attending the initiation of [[Larsh Hill]] into the [[Order of the Canted Circle]] in its [[Lodge of the Canted Circle|Lodge]] in the [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], accompanied by two of his [[Sun Guard]]s and [[11-4D/Legends|11-4D]], along with the other [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] attending, were '''attacked''' by [[Maladian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] later arrived to help Plagueis, but by then, Plagueis and 11-4D were the only ones still standing save for the Maladians, which Palpatine and Pestage dispatched with a [[Repeating blaster cannon/Legends|Repeating blaster cannon]]. Plagueis was severely wounded, forcing him to wear a [[Transpirator/Legends|transpirator]] from then on.<ref name="DP Novel" />

In the aftermath of the battle, two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] arrived at the scene in response to the [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbances]] that the battle had caused in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. They notified the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] of the situation. The remains of the Maladians were so scattered that the CSF [[Detective/Legends|detectives]] believed at first that an explosion had occurred though they could find no evidence of it. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] refused to inform the police as to their interest in the case and why they had been at the location in the first place. Later, the CSF attributed the carnage to a hit by organized crime.<ref name="DP Novel" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The event which would develop into the Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle was first conceived by ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] during the early planning stages of the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], around the late [[2000]]s. One of Lucas' tidbits for [[James Luceno]] during the project's early planning, aside from the fact that Plagueis should be a Muun, was that Plagueis wore a transpirator following an assassination attempt he suffered on his life.<ref name="Star Wars Action News Episode 338, 16-20 minutes">16 min - 20 min mark: {{WebCite|url=http://www.swactionnews.com/episode.htm?id=280|text=Episode 338: James Luceno the Wise|date=2012-03-19|work=Star Wars Action News|archivedate=20170227134552}}</ref>
